More features

Why Inphinit?

A small core, with the tools you actually need already built in.

Minimalist by design

A lightweight core that stays out of your way. Use only what your project needs, without a heavy stack to learn first.

Batteries included

Routing, controllers, views, sessions, validation, DOM and CSS selectors, CSV/TSV, Markdown and more, all ready to use.

Production-minded

HTTP cache with ETag, proxy and load balancer support, maintenance mode and task scheduling help you run in the real world.

Easy to debug

Built-in debugging, a checkup for your environment and custom error pages make problems easier to find and fix.

Per-environment settings

Keep configuration separated for development and production, so deployments stay predictable.

Command line friendly

Run tasks from the CLI and generate commands, controllers and views with the built-in make:* commands.

Join the community

Inphinit is open source. Contributions, bug reports and ideas are welcome.

Source code

Browse the repository, report issues and send pull requests on GitHub.

Guides for every feature, from routing to task scheduling.

What's new?

2.1 version

Changelog between versions 2.0 and 2.1:

  • https://github.com/inphinit/framework/compare/2.0...2.1
2.1-beta.21 version
  • Inphinit\Experimental\Http\Method class refactored.
  • x-forwarded-prefix header can now be used with RFC7239 (eg.: $forwarded->setFlags(Forwarded::PREFIX|Forwarded::RFC7239)).
  • Fixed Forwarded::getPrefix().
  • Fixed Inphinit\Dom\Selector class.
  • Fixed Inphinit\Filesystem\File.
  • Improved behavior of Scheduler::prioritizeBackgroundTasks() in PHP<8.
  • New method: Storage:temp().
  • The Config::commit() method has been removed, as its use could otherwise result in the loss of information regarding file permissions and ownership.
  • Renamed commands:
    • create:command -> make:command.
    • create:controller -> make:controller.
    • create:view -> make:view.
2.1-beta.20 version

Built-in commands:

  • New run create:command command.
  • New run create:controller command.
  • New run create:view command.
  • The run server command now checks whether the port is already in use.

FileGenerator improved:

  • Support header templates.
  • Fixed bugs.

Forwarded support:

  • Refactored and added support to the framework core.
  • By default, a 403 code will be sent if unknown proxies are detected.
